response.answer: An average sediment velocity of 6,000 ft/s was selected for the time-to-depth conversion of the New River seismic reflection records. This value was chosen after considering the average acoustic velocity of about 5,000 ft/s in the 3 to 15 ft of water where profiling was done and the estimated average velocity of 6,150 ft/s for the first 500 ft of sediment from the research station well; the seismic wavelet-borehole correlations match up well with the resultant time-to-depth conversions generated with this 6,000 ft/s sediment velocity estimate.
